analyzed_vuln.description: `ValidateArrayVisitor::ValidateListArray` unconditionally dereferences list offsets via `array.value_offset(0)` / `array.value_offset(array.length())` after `ValidateOffsets()`. For sliced `List/LargeList` arrays, `ValidateOffsets()` only checks `value_offsets` buffer byte size against `length + offset + 1`, but does not ensure the `BaseListArray` internal raw offset pointer is non-null/valid for this constructed array state. As a result, malformed IPC-produced array state can pass the size check yet leave `raw_value_offsets_` invalid, and `value_offset()` in `array.h` performs a wild read (crash at array.h:589).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzed IPC stream input must deserialize into a record batch containing a (Large)List array with inconsistent internal offset state (notably around offsets/slicing metadata). During `FuzzIpcStream`, each decoded batch is passed to `RecordBatch::ValidateFull()`, which calls `ValidateArray()` and then `ValidateListArray()`. If `length > 0`, `ValidateListArray()` reads first/last offsets through `value_offset()`; with corrupted list offset backing state, this triggers an out-of-bounds/wild read and SEGV.
